data.name: Hanfa
data.gender_notes: Hanfa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-n-f' which means 'to be gentle, soft, and beautiful'. In Islamic tradition, Hanfa is a beautiful name for a girl. The name Hanfa carries the meaning “Graceful, beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hanfa usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gentle and flowing nature of the river of life, representing the smooth journey of life and the grace and gentleness with which one navigates through life's challenges.
data.etymology: Hanfa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hanfa total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: هانفا
in_arabic.long_meaning: هانفا هو الاسم الذي يُؤدي إلى تعريف الشخص كمن يعطي حانفاً في الإسلام، حيث يُعد حانفاً من أسماء الله الحسنى في القرآن الكريم. يُستخدم هذا الاسم أيضًا للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يُعطى حنفاً من قبل الله، مما يمنحهم صفات الخير والمحبة. في الثقافة الإسلامية، يُعتبر الاسم هانفاً رمزًا للخير والتوحيد.

in_urdu.name: ہانفا
in_urdu.meaning: وہ شخص جو حنفا دیتا ہے
